newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight business brisker, Brazil prominent.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight business brisker, Brazil prominent.

text.p: Business perked up on London's sugar freight market on Tuesday with south Brazil prominent among the list of quoted origins, shipbrokers said.
Booker quoted for 9,500 tonnes of bulk sugar from Georgetown to UK/Nantes for the end of August.

Shipbrokers said Noble booked a vessel on account, possibly on behalf of Phibro, for 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from south Brazil to Red Sea plus various options for the end of August at around $42.
Secretan was said to have fixed 22,000 tonnes in bulk as agents from Santos to Casablanca with options of Black Sea, Baltic and Mediterranean, again for end-August.
Kerry Trading fixed 12,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from Thailand to Indonesia for end-august at under $16.
Louis Dreyfus entered the market with a new order for 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from south Brazil to Red Sea with Indian Ocean options for early September.
Lastly, Lorico was said to have fixed on subjects 10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Rio de Janeiro to Egyptian Mediterranean and Aqaba for early September.
